assignment.problem: Improve a fictional city intake workflow using only approved evidence.
assignment.intended_result: Recommend a source-backed improvement approach with alternatives, implementation steps, risks, and measurable outcomes.
constraints: Do not treat historical cost as a current quote.

sections.name: findings
sections.content: The intake workflow averages 9 business days of cycle time and has duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing.

sections.name: alternatives
sections.content: One alternative is a standardized checklist. A second combines the checklist with a triage step.

sections.name: recommendation
sections.content: Pilot the standardized checklist with a triage step because both are supported by the prior pilot evidence.

sections.name: implementation_steps
sections.content: Run a 6 week pilot, measure cycle time, rework count, and routing accuracy, then review the results before wider adoption.

sections.name: risks
sections.content: Duplicate data entry and inconsistent routing may continue if the checklist and triage step are not applied consistently.

missing_information: Real staffing capacity and current operating budget.
expert_review_needed: Operational feasibility should be reviewed by City staff.
